description:
Every disposition made pursuant to R. 3:25A-1 shall be set forth in an order or judgment which shall be filed in the county where such disposition is made and the county where the matter was pending. Unless the disposition is set aside, all subsequent proceedings shall be had in the county where such disposition was made, and copies of all orders and judgments entered in connection therewith shall be filed there.

Note: Adopted July 17, 1975 to be effective September 8, 1975.
